revokeExtension.reasonRequired: A reason is required to revoke an extension
revokeExtension.title: Revoke extension
revokeExtension.subtitle: {{summary}} · expires {{date}}
revokeExtension.explanation: The extension stops applying to new credit sales at once. It stays in the client's history as revoked, and the revocation is recorded in the audit log.

waiveInterest.reasonRequired: A reason is required to waive interest
waiveInterest.title: Waive interest
waiveInterest.explanation: The charge stays on the ledger marked as waived and is no longer owed. The waiver is recorded in the audit log. If this is the latest charge, the next interest run can charge its period again.

cancelInvoice.reasonRequired: A reason is required to cancel an invoice
cancelInvoice.title: Cancel invoice
cancelInvoice.explanation: The invoice stays on record marked as cancelled and its number is not reused. Its sales can then be put on a new invoice.

creditLimit.invalid: Credit limit must be 0 or a positive number
creditLimit.title: Set credit limit
creditLimit.label: Credit limit

interestSettings.invalidGraceDays: Grace days must be 0 or more
interestSettings.title: Interest settings
interestSettings.explanation: Simple interest is calculated as: outstanding × rate × (days / 30). Set rate to 0 to disable interest for this client.
interestSettings.graceHelp: Interest starts this many days after the first credit sale. Default is 1.
